remarks:
The first-floor bedroom is currently being used as a family room, but could also make the perfect home office, guest room, or primary suite. Features like these are nearly impossible to find in North Buffalo! The rest of the first floor offers a classic North Buffalo layout with a huge living room that flows openly into the dining room, along with a beautifully remodeled kitchen.

Another rare improvement for a city home is the brand-new drain tile and sump pump installed by Frank's Basement Systems. While much of North Buffalo and Kenmore experienced record rainfall and flooding in September, 163 Taunton stayed dry! This work also includes a transferable warranty for added peace of mind.

The second floor offers a classic North Buffalo setup with 3 bedrooms, 1 full bath, and a balcony with an updated rolled roof. Outside, the backyard features a fully fenced yard and a massive covered rear deck, creating an incredible space for entertaining or simply enjoying the outdoors.

This home offers so many options and tons of flexibility that are nearly impossible to find in other North Buffalo single-family homes. Some of the other notable upgrades include replacement windows throughout, real 3/4" hardwood floors, a remodeled kitchen with solid wood dovetailed drawers, quartz countertops, a granite breakfast bar, updated electrical, and copper plumbing.

And of course, the location is tough to beat. You’re just steps from Hertel Avenue and some of North Buffalo’s favorite destinations, including Hanna’s Frosty Treats.
